title: After a long break the Today widget still tells the member to lift heavier than last time
what: The 'what to beat' lines on the Today home-screen widget are worked out once, when the app was last open, and are kept for every later day, even weeks later. The workout screen works the target out again on the day: after 6 weeks or more away it holds or cuts the weight (about 10% lighter) and says how many weeks it has been. So a member coming back after two months sees 'Bench Press: previous 60 kg x 8, next 62.5 x 8' on the home screen, taps Start, and is told to lift about 54 kg instead.
expected: The widget never shows a target older than the break rule allows: after a long gap it drops the what-to-beat lines (or says to open the app for today's target), so the home screen and the workout screen give the same number.
who: members with the Today widget who stop opening the app for 6 weeks or more
how_often: every return after a break of 6 weeks or more without opening the app
fix_line: Store the date the targets were worked out and hide the what-to-beat lines once the break rule could change them

items.reason: Facts this area shows: days trained this week (widget vs Progress tab), today's workout and what-to-beat (widget, app-icon shortcut, workout screen), how busy the gym is (widget vs Gym tab), steps today, estimated calories and workout counts sent to Health Connect, next reminder. Dues, plan end, alerts, birthdays and member counts are not shown by the phone's own parts. These facts live on the phone, not in the gym database, so a Crispy Curves recount does not apply; compared by code.

Rule applied: week count and gym word differences already have findings; the what-to-beat difference after a break is new. The Health Connect send count and the rows sent use the same filter, so they match.

Edges tested by reading: the 7 days written ahead and the later entry (next week starts at 0, done today moves Today to the next routine), the reminder skip on a day already trained, usual training days with no history (falls back to the plan, then Mon/Wed/Fri), steps from local midnight, last night's sleep by real time, body weight for a day before the first weigh-in. Long gap: the widget targets are frozen.
Rule applied: one number wrong at the long-gap edge.

The week widget's 'N of goal' is counted from the same seven day marks it draws; the Health Connect 'Send N workouts' count uses the same rows that are sent; a lower week count only follows a deleted workout, which the member did.
Rule applied: no summary in this area differs from its own rows.
Opened the files that work numbers out: widgets, reminders, calories, Health Connect send and read, sleep, and the progression engine's break rule.

Today widget: the routine comes from the Today answer, the what-to-beat rows from the targets of the same routine (two functions, checked to agree on the routine). Week widget: count and marks from one function. Live workout card: the clock comes from the app's paused-aware base.
Compared on a long gap: the workout screen cuts the weight after 6 weeks, the widget keeps the old heavier target.
